lessons: Premise is false: tests/stage_replies.py defines only requisition_reply, review_verdict, implement_reply and script. It has no triage verdict builder (test_triage.py::reply) and no authored-ticket builder (test_triage.py::author_reply).

Scope in says the reply shapes for reply and author_reply come from tests/stage_replies.py with no copy. Scope out forbids editing that file. Those two rules cannot both hold, so the ticket fails as written.

Fix the ticket in one of two ways: (a) a prerequisite ticket adds triage and author reply builders to tests/stage_replies.py, listed in ## Depends on; or (b) limit the reuse rule to requisition_reply and move reply and author_reply into tests/loop_helpers.py unchanged.

Keep the rest of the ticket: the 48 import lines, the hub definitions moving to tests/loop_helpers.py, and the GitFake/FakeExec rewrites of repo, repository, escape_rig, admission_graph and notify_command were not disputed.
